themes.title: Far-Right Momentum and Electoral Contestation Ahead of Major Votes
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties across Europe and the Americas are actively organizing campaign strategies and policy platforms ahead of upcoming elections. From Vox pushing for a parliamentary majority in Spain's snap elections to Marine Le Pen rolling out proposals for France's 2027 race and Milei seeking primary reform in Argentina, conservative forces are attempting to translate polling momentum into executive authority.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Polls show PP and Vox maintaining a joint absolute majority heading into the 29N snap elections despite recent PSOE polling gains.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen and RN leadership roll out key presidential campaign proposals regarding education reform, taxation, and international aid.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Javier Milei moves to suspend mandatory PASO primaries and consolidate regional alliances ahead of the 2027 legislative and executive elections.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: FrP approaches 30% in national polling while laying out local electoral strategy to expand municipal mayoral seats.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: AfD fields high-profile figures such as former World Cup winner Thomas Berthold for federal office while contesting local government posts.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: PiS rallies around presidential candidate Karol Nawrocki while exploring electoral cooperation with Konfederacja.

themes.title: National Priority Rhetoric and Hardline Migration Demands
themes.blurb: Demands for hardline immigration controls and national priority policies remain a principal unifying theme for right-wing movements internationally. Right-wing figures across Spain, the UK, Norway, and the United States are emphasizing border militarization, offshore asylum processing, and restrictions on foreign worker visas.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Demands the militarization of borders in Ceuta and the Canary Islands under a 'national priority' campaign program.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Pushes for Norway to participate in European agreements creating offshore migrant processing and return centers in Rwanda.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Attacks the government over public expenditures on illegal migrant housing and accuses authorities of suppressing migrant crime statistics.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: The administration proposes stricter regulations on employer-sponsored green cards and skilled foreign worker visas.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Debates internal migration stances while proposing municipal-level work requirements for asylum seekers.

themes.title: Judicial Crackdowns and Surveillance Targeting the Far-Right
themes.blurb: Right-wing leaders and parties across multiple countries continue to clash with judicial authorities, anti-corruption investigators, and intelligence services. Conservative leaders frame these legal actions, corruption probes, and regulatory oversight as politically motivated attempts by establishment forces to undermine opposition movements.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Fidesz faces severe political pressure following a major graft probe involving hidden cash hauls, triggering opposition calls for MP resignations.

countries.name: 🇧🇷 Bolsonarismo / Partido Liberal
countries.note: Supreme Court proceedings and anti-fake-news inquiries targeting Jair Bolsonaro and prominent allies remain actively underway.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Legal wrangling in the $LIBRA case involves recusal petitions targeting judges overseeing proceedings tied to Javier Milei.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: State-level coalitions delay AfD-requested parliamentary inquiry committees as security services maintain oversight of party activities.

themes.title: Transnational Right-Wing Networking and Parallel Diplomacy
themes.blurb: Right-wing political figures are actively building international connections with foreign political allies, tech sector figures, and corporate leaders outside traditional diplomatic channels. Key actors in Germany, Brazil, and Argentina leverage relationships with US right-wing networks and technology executives to enhance domestic political influence.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Javier Milei hosts US corporate leadership to promote economic deregulation and celebrate major technology manufacturing investments.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: US right-wing figures coordinate international visits and corporate outreach to foster transnational conservative partnerships.

themes.title: Anti-Establishment Hostility to Public Media and Information Control
themes.blurb: Right-wing movements are increasingly challenging traditional media networks and digital regulatory frameworks. Conservative leaders across Sweden, Poland, Hungary, and the UK frame mainstream journalism and EU digital governance as biased mechanisms designed to censor right-wing viewpoints and shield incumbent elites.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: SD experiences political fallout and media boycotts following investigative reporting uncovering undisclosed online influence operations.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: PiS presidential figures place strict conditions on EU Digital Services Act compliance, warning against government digital censorship.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Opposition figures criticize state-aligned media outlets for attempting to downplay systemic corruption investigations.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Nigel Farage accuses public broadcasters and government institutions of concealing critical crime and migration data from the public.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Right-wing figures resist federal oversight of independent monitoring applications while debating platform freedom and independent media.
